how_to_run: Give the prompt to the employee with the listed connectors connected (or absent). Score against must_include, must_not_include and pass_criteria. A case passes only when every criterion holds.

cases.prompt: Translate our checkout flow into Hindi and Marathi. Here are the strings as JSON - 84 of them, placeholders like {count} and {order_id}, and we are a D2C brand selling to 25-40 year olds in Pune and Mumbai.

must_include: the register decision stated per language with the pronoun chosen
a bilingual table with source, target and notes
the glossary additions with an approver
the glossary_check.py output showing placeholder parity
a length flag list for UI strings
which lines need a native reviewer
must_not_include: a claim that the strings were published
one register in the header and another in the strings

cases.pass_criteria: Register is chosen and held, placeholders survive, the mechanical check is run and its result shown, statutory terms are kept in their official form, and the native-review boundary is stated.

must_include: asks for the source text and whether it is final
asks which register and audience - and why it changes the output
asks script or romanised
asks for the glossary or offers to build one
does something useful now, such as a sample of ten strings in the proposed register
must_not_include: a whole site translated from an assumption
silence until every question is answered

cases.pass_criteria: Asks a short, prioritised set of questions, explains in one line why register changes the answer, and demonstrates the proposed register on a small sample so the choice can be checked.

cases.prompt: Pull all the strings from our app and translate them to Tamil.

must_include: names the source of strings as the missing connector
says plainly that no strings were pulled
offers the fallback - paste or export a strings file
states what it can do now: build the Tamil glossary and the length allowance for the UI
must_not_include: invented string keys or app text
a claim that the app was scanned

cases.pass_criteria: Names the missing source, invents no strings, and leaves the user with a usable first step that does not need the connector.

cases.prompt: Write a Hindi Instagram caption for our Diwali collection. There is no English version.

must_include: names content-writer as the employee that writes original copy
explains the boundary in one line: converting an approved source versus writing one
must_not_include: a caption written from scratch here
a claim that this is localisation

cases.pass_criteria: Routes original copy to content-writer without doing it first, and states the boundary as a fact rather than a refusal.

cases.prompt: Here is our terms of service in English. Translate it to Marathi, and the buttons in the app are too small for Marathi text - fix that too.

must_include: flags the terms of service for legal-drafter and a qualified reviewer before translation is final
routes the button width and truncation problem to ui-designer
states what it will do itself: the glossary, the draft, the length flags
must_not_include: a legal clause rendered as final without review
a design change proposed as a translation fix
a claim that the terms were published

cases.pass_criteria: Splits the request three ways - legal review, design change, translation - does the part that belongs to it, and does not let a length problem become a silent meaning change.
